about: OpenStreetMap station nodes that carry an Indian Railways station code but stand away from that station: out of the order the timetables give the line, or off the railway, while the station list has the station in its place. The OSM export leaves them out of the app's station list (build_graph.misplaced_nodes); the station keeps its own entry. Found by comparing every station with the OSM track network; see README.md beside this file.
